VLA_TRACK.description: Gapless Real-Time Control SLA for Track 1 VLA: pi05-3b requires p99 <= 250.0 ms (>= 4.0 Chunks/s, K_eval=5); gr00t-n1.7-3b requires p99 <= 400.0 ms (>= 2.5 Chunks/s, K_eval=8).

VLA_TRACK_1A_PI05.description: Gapless Real-Time Control SLA for Track 1A (pi05-3b): p99 <= 250.0 ms (>= 4.0 Chunks/s), anchored to locked K_eval=5 at 20 Hz control (5 * 50 ms = 250 ms).

VLA_TRACK_1B_GR00T.description: Gapless Real-Time Control SLA for Track 1B (gr00t-n1.7-3b): p99 <= 400.0 ms (>= 2.5 Chunks/s), anchored to locked K_eval=8 at 20 Hz control (8 * 50 ms = 400 ms).

WM_TRACK.description: Gapless Real-Time Control SLA for Track 2 World Models (cosmos-predict2.5-2b): p99 <= 1000.0 ms (>= 1.0 Pred/s), anchored to interactive 1 Hz world-model rollouts (16 frames per prediction).
